title: Wynncraft MMORPG
description: Wynncraft is the largest fully-featured MMORPG Minecraft server. No mods required!
body:
Wynncraft is the largest fully-featured MMORPG Minecraft server. No mods required!

Explore a vast and rich world with thousands of other players!
Forge your own path! No mods are required to play.

Choose between 5 classes and 15 archetypes. Level up, trade on the player market, slay bosses, discover secrets and loot, capture territories with your guildmates, and much more. The choice is yours!
